scope: F2 physics sidecar parsing, validation, persistence, collector recovery, and promotion

notes: The recovery boundary does not convert an expected filesystem shape error into its typed PhysicsArtifactError outcome.
tests/test_physics_capture_contract.py:207 uses an implementation-specific read_text patch that does not prove the stated whole-file-read behavior.
The Path.read_text patch is a tautological/implementation-mirroring test: a regression to another whole-file API would remain green.
No unnecessary production extraction, parsing, or normalization was found in the F2 persistence boundary.

HIGH.title: A non-directory frames artifact leaks NotADirectoryError instead of failing closed
HIGH.detail: validate_physics_shot_artifact calls frames_dir.iterdir() without translating OSError to PhysicsArtifactError. recover_physics_capture_attempts only catches PhysicsArtifactError at scripts/collect_rollouts.py:958, so a corrupt completed shot aborts resume and remains in the accepted-shot namespace.
HIGH.requiredFix: Normalize the malformed frames-directory failure into PhysicsArtifactError (or make recovery catch and quarantine the applicable filesystem errors), then add an observable recovery test for this completed-shot shape.

MEDIUM.title: Whole-file-read test does not distinguish the behavior it names
MEDIUM.detail: Patching Path.read_text is ineffective because the parser uses open/readline. A future whole-file read via read_bytes or open().read() would pass this test. tests/test_collect_rollouts.py:219 has the materially relevant early-boundary test by asserting _read_jsonl is never entered for an oversized sidecar.
MEDIUM.requiredFix: Delete this redundant test or replace it with a behavior-level bounded-read test that fails for every whole-file parsing path.

blockers: Recovery must fail closed for every malformed completed-shot filesystem shape, including a non-directory frames path; it currently aborts with NotADirectoryError and leaves the bad shot in place.
The stated whole-file-read test should be corrected or removed because it provides false confidence.
